items.scene: Mina arrived 20 minutes late, her sleeves were damp, and she gave short answers. She said she got caught in heavy rain.
items.question: Which explanation best fits the evidence?
options: She was delayed by the rain and was rushing to dry off.
She was upset with the group and did not want to talk.
She had forgotten the meeting and came only after being reminded.
She was too tired from work to answer in full sentences.
items.why_this_case_matters: This is the core task: compare multiple plausible explanations and choose the one that fits the clues with the fewest extra assumptions.

items.scene: A teacher asks why a student missed class. The student was absent, and the desk was empty.
items.question: Which option names the evidence directly shown in the scene?
options: The student was absent from class.
The student wanted to avoid the teacher.
The student forgot about the lesson.
items.why_this_case_matters: This is a near-miss because it asks for direct evidence, not the best explanation among competing interpretations.

items.scene: After a meeting, two coworkers both stayed quiet. One person thinks the other is being rude and says so to a manager.
items.question: What is the main issue being checked here?
options: Which explanation best fits the silence.
Whether the coworker was actually rude.
Whether the manager agrees with the complaint.
Whether the speaker is being biased or too judgmental.
items.why_this_case_matters: This is a boundary case because the task is about bias and judgment, not choosing the best explanation for the silence.

items.scene: Jorge smiled after reading a text, then sat down quietly. His friend said he must be happy. Jorge later said the text said his lost passport had been found.
items.question: Which explanation best accounts for the scene?
options: He was happy about the text and stayed quiet because the news was a relief.
He was embarrassed and smiled to hide it from his friend.
He was angry at the sender but pretended to be calm.
He was bored and smiled only because he was tired.
items.why_this_case_matters: This case includes a likely wrong shortcut: the smile is salient, but the full clue set better fits relief from the lost passport being found.
